card.flavorText: The Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress was an American heavy bomber that was developed in the 1930s and used by the USAAF and RAF in WWII. The B-17 had a reputation of being a tough aircraft and could take a lot of battle damage and still reach its target and bring the crew home safely. The B-17F was one of many variants, with 3,405 units built, one of them being the famous Memphis Belle  which was an aircraft of the Eighth Air Force and the first B-17 to complete 25 combat missions. A total of 12,731 B-17s were built and 46 of them still survive today.
